context.problem_statement: Analyze a 2x2 factorial experiment measuring the effect of temperature (Low/High) and pressure (Low/High) on material yield. Perform two-way ANOVA to test: (1) main effect of temperature (F-stat and p-value), (2) main effect of pressure (F-stat and p-value), (3) interaction effect of temperature x pressure (F-stat and p-value), (4) compute eta-squared (effect size) for each effect = SS_effect / SS_total, (5) if interaction is significant, perform simple effects analysis: test temperature effect separately at each pressure level. Report the ANOVA table with SS, df, MS, F, and p-value for each effect.
context.expert_knowledge: Two-way ANOVA using statsmodels: ols('yield ~ C(temperature) * C(pressure)', data=df).fit() then anova_lm(model, typ=2). Type II SS is recommended for balanced designs. Eta-squared = SS_effect / SS_total. Significant interaction means main effects must be interpreted with caution. Simple effects: subset data by one factor and run one-way ANOVA on the other. Assumption checks: Levene's test for homogeneity, Shapiro-Wilk for normality of residuals.
